title: Thursday, the dog returns
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
logline: Thursday. The dog comes back. He sits at the door and won't pass the machine. Gully turns it off. The dog comes in. Gully turns it on. The dog leaves. The strip is a negotiation in four panels.

panels.composition: The shack door. BARNABY, three, sitting outside it, looking at the machine. GULLY, WOOD.

image.prompt: brush-pen black-and-white, xerox grain, a small dog sitting outside a bait shack's door looking warily at a chrome espresso machine inside, two teenagers watching

panels.composition: Gully reaching over. The machine's switch. Off. The hiss dying. The dog's ears.

image.prompt: brush-pen black-and-white, xerox grain, a teenager switching off an espresso machine as a small dog's ears lift

panels.composition: The dog in. Under the crate. Gully's hand back on the switch. On. The dog out, a streak.

image.prompt: brush-pen black-and-white, xerox grain, a small dog streaking out a shack door as a teenager's hand flips an espresso machine back on

panels.composition: Off. The dog in. Gully's hand off the switch, for good, for now. Wood drawing the switch.

image.prompt: brush-pen black-and-white, xerox grain, a small dog settled under a crate while a teenager takes his hand off an espresso machine's switch, another drawing

art.line: brush-pen, committed; xerox; black and white

notes: The dog and the switch. 'Same thing, in here.'
